name: smart-notch
changelog: A fresh new look: A calmer, cleaner design for the notch, alerts, bar and settings, with a new battery ring and logo.
Lights that move to your music: The music bars, album glow and effects now pulse to the beat of whatever is playing.
New background effects: Visualizer, Waves and Synthwave in your album's colours, plus Fireflies, Holographic and Topographic.
More reliable popups: Bluetooth, volume and brightness popups keep working after connecting headphones or waking from sleep.
Better bar mode: Focus timer, calendar and quick toggles in the side bar, and a startable timer in the top bar.
Smoother dragging: See where the notch will land while dragging, and it keeps up with quick moves.
Update notices: Get a heads-up when a new version is in the Microsoft Store, and see what's new after updating.
author: Avinash
description: Smart Notch – a Dynamic Island experience for Windows.
